FX-CELL-001.says: Bubbles, four pixels a cell, the other settings as they start: invert off, contrast 100, disperse 1, evolution 0, seed 0, black to white, opacity 100, normal. The card is covered by grey balls, white at each cell's point and dark where cells meet, the drawing gone under them, every pixel at its own covering and the empty pixels empty.

FX-CELL-002.says: Crystals: faceted cones, darker than the bubbles away from the points.

FX-CELL-003.says: Plates: flat white plates, dark only close to the seams.

FX-CELL-004.says: Static plates: each cell one flat grey of its own.

FX-CELL-005.says: Invert on: FX-CELL-001 turned over, dark balls on light seams.

FX-CELL-006.says: Contrast 300: the greys pushed out towards black and white.

FX-CELL-007.says: Contrast 0: every pixel that shows the middle grey, halfway from black to white.

FX-CELL-008.says: Disperse 0: every point in its cell's middle, so the balls sit in a square grid, the pattern repeating every four pixels.

FX-CELL-009.says: Disperse 0 and evolution 90: a point in its cell's middle has no circle to go round, so the frame is FX-CELL-008's.

FX-CELL-010.says: Evolution 90: the points turned a quarter of the way round their circles, the balls moved.

FX-CELL-012.says: Seed 7.9: the whole part counted, so the frame is FX-CELL-011's.

FX-CELL-013.says: Size 1000: one cell far larger than the card, so the card sees one soft part of a ball.

FX-CELL-014.says: Colours #203070 to #FFD060, the second in capitals: navy seams and gold balls.

FX-CELL-015.says: Opacity 50: the balls laid on at half strength over the card.

FX-CELL-017.says: Blend multiply: the card darkened by the pattern, the line still dark.

FX-CELL-018.says: Blend add at opacity 30: the card lightened by the pattern.

FX-CELL-019.says: Evolution keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 360 at frame 4, linear: the balls move round and are back where they began at frame 4; frame 0 is FX-CELL-001.

FX-CELL-020.says: Size keyed from 4 at frame 0 to 1000 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 2 would pass 1000, is held at 1000, and is size 1000.

FX-CELL-021.says: FX-CELL-001 moved three pixels right: the pattern moves with the drawing.

FX-CELL-022.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the pattern is fixed to the drawing's own space, so the frame is FX-CELL-001's.

FX-CELL-023.says: Size 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CELL-024.says: Size 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CELL-025.says: Disperse 1.6, above 1.5. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CELL-026.says: Contrast -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CELL-027.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CELL-028.says: Seed -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CELL-029.says: Pattern "tubular", which is not "bubbles", "crystals", "plates" or "static_plates". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CELL-030.says: Invert "yes", which is not "on" or "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CELL-031.says: Light colour "#12345", not six hex digits. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CELL-032.says: Blend "darken", which is not "normal", "multiply", "screen" or "add". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CELL-033.says: Disperse keyed to 1.6 at frame 4, above 1.5. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
